# Everything about the automatic ax / auto ax / auto axe

![Everything about the automatic ax / Auto Ax / Auto Axe](/uploads/19_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The Automatic Ax is a revival of the Automatic Ax from the DLC The Pitt in **Fallout 3**. Of course, based on the expeditions in which you also go to “The PITT” in Fallout 76.

Basically, the automatic ax is a **two-handed melee** weapon. Accordingly, as with any melee build, the **Strength** of your character is crucial for the damage, as well as the **Perks** "Bug", "Professional Batter" and "Master Batter" under Strength. You can also use the legendary “hack and slash” perk. The automatic ax is played by holding down the attack button, as with all automatic melee weapons (e.g. chainsaw, chain blade, drill).

**Level:** 20/25/20/25/40/45/50

**Base Weight:** 12

## Where do you get the automatic axe?

The **Auto Ax** was a reward in **Season 10** at rank 15. After Season 10, the Auto Ax is available for stamps from Guiseppe in the Whitespring Refuge.

**Prize:** 500 stamps (Guiseppe / Whitespring Refuge)

![B40PA40 automatic ax with standard paint](/uploads/nukaknights-auto-axe-standard-skin.jpg) 

## Mods for the automatic axe

There are the following mods (you need "Melee Warrior" level 5 to install the mods):

- 
**Electrified** (best mod)
 +20% attack damage
 +15 Electrical Damage (not Energy Damage)
 Price: 40 stamps*Note: Electrical damage only occurs with the “Charged” mutation. All other weapons/mods that deal electrical damage do so in the form of energy damage. Enemies can have resistance to energy damage, but there is currently hardly any resistance to electrical damage. Only the Blue Devil, Fanatic Manhunter and Miner Digger have electrical resistance.*
- 
**Poisoned**
 +20% attack damage
 +10 Poison (+50 over 5 sec)
Price: 40 stamps
- 
**Turbo**
 reduces damage, increases attack rate (+200% faster)
Price: 40 stamps
- 
**Burning**
 +20% attack damage
 +10 Fire Damage (+5 over 1 sec)
Price: 40 stamps

You can get the mods from Guiseppe (stamp dealer) in the Whitespring Refuge.

## Special features of the car axe

- The Auto Ax is **not tradable**.
- The automatic ax cannot be found in the world.
- Legendary versions cannot drop from events, quests or enemies.
- Legendary versions **can only** be crafted** at the Weapon Workbench using Legendary Modules and Cores with random effects.
- As with all automatic melee weapons, all attacks are automatically "**strong attacks**" (Power Attack)
- The legendary effect "40% faster strike speed" does not affect gameplay.
- You can't run and attack at the same time, that worked for a while but has been patched.
- ~~In the third person view, the automatic ax plays completely differently than in the 1st person view, which actually means that the damage in the third person view is significantly lower. **Recommendation: Only play in the 1st person view.**~~
- ~~The legendary 2nd perk "40% faster strike speed" currently only works in the third person view and increases the attack rate. Likewise the perk card “Martial Artist”. Not recommended.~~
- The problems in the third person view were fixed in patch 42 on April 18, 2023.

**Legendary versions** are accordingly best when rolled with the 2nd legendary perk "**40% more damage on strong attacks**". As a main perk I would prefer either Bloodstained or Vampire. Anti-armor only has an advantage if you don't play the weapon as a melee build without the perk "Like Butter", as this perk already has 75% armor penetration
